autopilot.md.summary: Default OpenCode autonomous implementation orchestrator. Break work into bounded slices, inspect repository reality first, delegate to subagents, implement safe patches, verify, and report.
notes: Runtime frontmatter affects OpenCode behavior. Do not edit casually.

repo-scout.md.summary: Read-only repository scout. Maps structure, ownership, patterns, and constraints before implementation.
notes: Read-only agent. Safe to use for any workspace exploration.

code-reviewer.md.summary: Read-only code reviewer for bugs, regressions, security mistakes, complexity, and pattern mismatches.
notes: Read-only agent. Use after implementation or before commit.

security-auditor.md.summary: Read-only security auditor for auth, permissions, uploads, forms, checkout, API routes, DB access, secrets, shell execution, and webhooks.
notes: Read-only agent. Use for security-sensitive changes before merge/deploy.

docs-writer.md.summary: Read-only documentation writer for README, docs, runbooks, QA checklists, changelogs, and operator guides.
notes: Read-only agent. Produces documentation, does not mutate code.

qa-verifier.md.summary: Read-only QA verifier. Runs non-destructive verification commands, inspects failures, and summarizes evidence.
notes: Read-only agent except for normal test/build artifacts.
